column1: # The LOCAL C4 CAMPAIGN profile: the scientific settings of profiles/genotype_c4.tsv, key for key and value
# for value (the campaign gate checks that), with two process settings changed for one 16 GiB workstation
#   footprint_limit_bytes  3.5 GiB per process (3758096384), not 2.5 GiB: at 30x the union pass leaves a
#                          run-to-run-variable allocator footprint the repair then carries, and NA19240 LOO
#                          30x crossed 2.5 GiB once while its live data was ~1.4 GB. Not a new global default.
#   time_limit_seconds     3600 per process: a campaign job that runs past it is stopped (TIME_LIMIT), not
#                          left running; the slowest measured production job took 442 s at 8 threads.
# The thread count is NOT set here: the campaign scheduler supplies --threads, and every run records it as
# settings_overridden_after_profile threads=<n>. The result does not depend on the thread count.
